# CVE-2025-3000: PyTorch is vulnerable to memory corruption through its torch.jit.script function

(updated )

A vulnerability classified as critical has been found in PyTorch 2.6.0. This affects the function torch.jit.script. The manipulation leads to memory corruption. It is possible to launch the attack on the local host. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

# CVE-2025-3000

Safety vulnerability ID: SFTY-20250331-30014

Affected versions of the torch package are vulnerable to Memory Corruption due to improper handling of input data. The `torch.jit.script` function fails to adequately validate and sanitize input, allowing crafted data to corrupt memory structures. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by executing a specially crafted script on the local host, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or application crashes.
